description: Gives the opponent’s side the Stealth Rock status.

name: Springtide Storm
description: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.

name: Mystical Power
description: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: Raging Fury
description: The user gains the Rampaging status.

name: Wave Crash
description: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.

name: Chloroblast
description: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

name: Mountain Gale
description: Has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

name: Victory Dance
description: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

name: Headlong Rush
description: Lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats by 1 stage.

name: Barb Barrage
description: Has a 50% chance of poisoning the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.

name: Esper Wing
description: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

name: Bitter Malice
description: Lowers the target’s Attack stat by 1 stage.

name: Shelter
description: Boosts the user’s Defense stat by 2 stages.

name: Triple Arrows
description: Has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat by 1 stage and has a 30% chance of making the target flinch. This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.

name: Infernal Parade
description: Has a 30% chance of burning the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

name: Ceaseless Edge
description: Gives the opponent’s side the Spikes status.

name: Bleakwind Storm
description: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.

name: Wildbolt Storm
description: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

name: Sandsear Storm
description: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.

name: Lunar Blessing
description: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

name: Take Heart
description: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

name: Tera Blast
description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

name: Silk Trap
description: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

name: Axe Kick
description: Has a 30% chance of confusing the target. If this move misses or fails, the user takes damage equal to 1/2 of its max HP.

name: Last Respects
description: This move’s power is increased by 50 for each time that a Pokémon in the user’s party has fainted.

name: Lumina Crash
description: Lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat by 2 stages.

name: Order Up
description: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.

name: Jet Punch
description: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

name: Spicy Extract
description: Lowers the target’s Defense stat by 2 stages and boosts its Attack stat by 2 stages.

name: Spin Out
description: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.

name: Population Bomb
description: The user attacks 1 to 10 times in a row. The attack ends if the user misses.

name: Ice Spinner
description: Removes any terrain.

name: Glaive Rush
description: The user gains the Wide Open status until the next time it takes an action.

name: Revival Blessing
description: Revives a Pokémon in the user’s party that has fainted and restores 1/2 of that Pokémon’s max HP.

name: Salt Cure
description: Gives the target the Salt Cured status.

name: Triple Dive
description: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

name: Mortal Spin
description: Removes the Bound and Leech Seeded statuses from the user and removes the Sticky Web, Stealth Rock, Spikes, and Toxic Spikes statuses from the user’s side. Poisons targets.

name: Doodle
description: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

name: Fillet Away
description: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

name: Kowtow Cleave
description: This move never misses.

name: Flower Trick
description: This move never misses and is always a critical hit.

name: Torch Song
description: Boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat by 1 stage.

name: Aqua Step
description: Boosts the user’s Speed stat by 1 stage.

name: Raging Bull
description: Removes the Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil statuses on the target’s side. This move’s type depends on the user’s form.

name: Make It Rain
description: Lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat by 2 stages.

name: Psyblade
description: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.

name: Hydro Steam
description: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.

name: Ruination
description: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

name: Collision Course
description: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

name: Electro Drift
description: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

name: Shed Tail
description: The user loses 1/2 of its max HP to create a substitute, then switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon. The substitute will be hit by moves instead of that Pokémon, and it will vanish when it takes damage equal to 1/4 of the user’s max HP.

name: Chilly Reception
description: Summons snow for 5 turns. The user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.

name: Tidy Up
description: Removes the Sticky Web, Stealth Rock, Substitute, Spikes, and Toxic Spikes statuses from the entire field. Boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats by 1 stage.

name: Snowscape
description: Summons snow for 5 turns.

name: Pounce
description: Lowers the target’s Speed stat by 1 stage.

name: Trailblaze
description: Boosts the user’s Speed stat by 1 stage.

name: Chilling Water
description: Lowers the target’s Attack stat by 1 stage.

name: Hyper Drill
description: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

name: Twin Beam
description: The user attacks twice in a row.

name: Rage Fist
description: This move’s power is increased by 50 each time the user takes damage from a move, up to a maximum power of 350. If the user switches out of battle, the move’s power returns to its usual value.

name: Armor Cannon
description: Lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats by 1 stage.

name: Bitter Blade
description: The user’s HP is restored by 1/2 of the damage dealt by this move.

name: Double Shock
description: The user loses the Electric type. This move fails unless it is used by an Electric type.

name: Gigaton Hammer
description: This move can’t be used twice in a row.

name: Comeuppance
description: The user retaliates to deal 150% of the damage it took from an opponent’s move during the turn this move is used.

name: Aqua Cutter
description: This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.

name: Blood Moon
description: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.

name: Matcha Gotcha
description: Has a 20% chance of burning targets. The user’s HP is restored by 1/2 of the damage dealt by this move.

name: Syrup Bomb
description: Gives the target the Syrupy status for 3 turns.

name: Ivy Cudgel
description: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

name: Electro Shot
description: The user gains the Charging status on the turn this move is used, then attacks on the following turn. In rain, the user does not gain the Charging status and can attack immediately. The user’s Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 1 stage on the turn this move is used.

name: Tera Starstorm
description: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

name: Fickle Beam
description: This move has a 30% chance of its power being doubled.

name: Burning Bulwark
description: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

name: Thunderclap
description: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

name: Mighty Cleave
description: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

name: Tachyon Cutter
description: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

name: Hard Press
description: The more HP the target has left, the greater this move’s power (ranging between 1 and 100).

name: Dragon Cheer
description: Gives allies a Critical-Hit Ratio Boost. Dragon types receive a 2-stage boost. All other types receive a 1-stage boost.

name: Alluring Voice
description: Confuses the target if its stats were boosted during the turn this move is used.

name: Temper Flare
description: This move’s power is doubled if the user couldn’t act or its move missed or failed on the previous turn.

name: Supercell Slam
description: If this move misses or fails, the user takes damage equal to 1/2 of its max HP. If the target has the Minimized status, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

name: Psychic Noise
description: Gives the target the Healing Prevented status for 2 turns.

name: Upper Hand
description: Makes the target flinch. This move fails if the target isn’t about to use a priority attack.

name: Malignant Chain
description: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
